note: A grass clearing in the woods, about 40 m by 15 m on imagery, just past the fork of Mitchell Trail and about 0.2 mile off Bark Road; secluded, with a stone fire ring. The last stretch is the trail itself, a two-track that DCNR calls 'a little rough', and the site is grass, so it may be soft when wet. Back-in. Bark Road is gravel, about 1.2 miles from US 30 on top of Sideling Hill to Mitchell Trail. No toilet; pack out trash. State forest roads get no winter maintenance and are not plowed. --Claude
summary: Site page re-read: still listed and bookable online, Drive-In, RV/Tent/Trailer categories, max vehicle length 50 ft, back-in. Fees confirmed and the $6.50 reservation fee added; booking, hookups, season confirmed; pull_through set false; toilets/water written as none. Imagery (leaf-off): grass clearing at the pin, entered by a two-track from the west. NHD: no water within 200 m. Phone 717-485-3148 confirmed. Not an ATV site (the brochure's ATV sites are SH032 and SH035 on Cove Road).
